t: Statement on Petco ending rabbit sales
s: A number of consumers, animal advocates and animal welfare organizations had expressed deep concerns after Petco recently began selling commercially raised rabbits in some of its stores. Kitty Block, president and CEO of the Humane Society of the United States, said: “Petco is doing right by rabbits by recommitting to an adoption-only policy.
